_comment: Maces. Vanilla has no mace on 1.20.1 (added in 1.21), so it carries no vanilla entry - it exists so a mod or pack can classify a modded mace without this code learning a mod-specific rule. The toolbar.mace factories still ship so the class is not silent once something is tagged. Spartan Weaponry's own weapon-type tags are listed below: that mod ships no vanilla/loader tag for these weapons on this version, and its tags contain only its own items, so the reference is optional and resolves to nothing without the mod.
